# Both recipes are read once the file parses (`languages/ci/just:B3`); the
# format string in `hello` sits inside ONE hole, the interpolation just
# opens at the line's `{{`.
repeat | shell | JustRecipe | sh errexit nounset | {{ count }} | "echo {{ count }}"
hello | shell | JustRecipe | sh errexit nounset | {{ f"hi {{name}}" }} | "echo {{ f\"hi {{name}}\" }}"
